Canon Supersession & Cleanup Ledger
Version: 1.8
Date: 2026-09-24

ACTIVE/PROMOTED
- smallest adequate implementation; recover/discover/reuse/integrate before build
- native/user-installed/network/provider capabilities first-class
- information may remain in authoritative existing systems
- GrandMasterRegister owns entity catalogue; AppDevRules/edenOSrules contain no catalogue; lookup user opt-in
- release channel OFFICIAL/DEVELOPMENT/EXPERIMENTAL
- authority STANDARD/ADMIN as independent dimension
- audience PRIVATE/FAMILY/FRIENDS/PUBLIC as independent deployment dimension
- nested Family/Friends groups/users; Recommended/Custom inheritance/deltas
- BIFROST deployment composition/handoff for applicable targets
- capability-aware deployment; simple Nodes/controllers do not inherit irrelevant complexity
- human-readable TXT access in Lucas Private build
- Nodes, shared capability independence, control-plane/data-plane separation
- Web-first testing, LKG, truthful testing, independent version dimensions

SUPERSEDED
- LCAS as edenOS runtime/service/system operational-state owner; LCAS is Chat UI only
- AOS as separate current global execution owner; historical identity preserved as provenance
- historical HEIMDALL ownership of EDEN-generic identity/registry/location/provider architecture
- Keychain as universal credential architecture
- BIFROST specialist ownership inferred from discovery/connection
- flat ADMIN/DEVELOPMENT combined access category
- mixing PRIVATE/FAMILY/FRIENDS/PUBLIC with release maturity
- embedding EDEN App/Helper lists in AppDevRules or edenOSrules

EXPERIMENTAL BRIDGES
- current direct BIFROST Experimental App update/install path
- direct BIFROST device OTA path used for integration testing
These may bootstrap rapid testing but never establish permanent ownership.

UNRESOLVED
- exact PROMETHEUS/DAEDALUS Mechanical vs Electrical mapping; do not guess.

HISTORICAL SOURCE RULE
Older files remain provenance/recovery evidence. Conflicting historical text cannot promote itself back into active canon.
